summary: Verified the Welspun_July_2026.xlsx multi-sheet + 'Name' header fix end-to-end. Backend upload returns bound_rows=885, ti_row_count=885, warning=null, ti_ingest_error=null; GET /api/dashboard/threat-intel flips to data_status=live with summary.total_advisories=60. UI shows ti-data-source-chip 'LIVE FROM UPLOAD · welspun.xlsx · 885 rows' and kpi-total-advisories=60 without a page reload. Regression paths (bad_cols.csv → 0 bound + explicit warning; xsoar_sample.csv → 2 bound live SOC) still behave correctly. DB cleaned after tests.

issues: 'Rows in file' label shows 64 (first-sheet row count) while 'Bound to dashboard' correctly shows 885 (aggregated across all sheets). Slightly confusing — consider reporting the aggregated total-rows-in-file for multi-sheet xlsx to avoid apparent contradiction.
Multiple Recharts warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render (benign, chart eventually renders correctly).

action_items: Cosmetic: align 'Rows in file' in UploadModal result panel with the aggregated row count when the xlsx has multiple sheets (currently shows only first sheet's rows).
critical_code_review_comments: ti_ingest.parse_rows correctly uses pd.read_excel(sheet_name=None) and aggregates via _rows_from_df across all sheets — verified with real user file (2 sheets → 885 canonical rows).
_CANONICAL mapping of 'name'/'title'/'sector' now matches the real file's header ('Name'), so total_advisories distinct count = 60 exactly as expected.
UploadModal source-aware feedback + qc.invalidateQueries() correctly makes the dashboard reflect the new data without reload (verified visually).
seed_data_creation: None; used existing /tmp/welspun.xlsx, /tmp/bad_cols.csv, /tmp/xsoar_sample.csv. Cleaned uploaded rows via DELETE /api/dashboard/threat-intel/data and /api/dashboard/soc-manager/data for tenant globalbank.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welspun multi-sheet + 'Name' header fix confirmed working. Backend: bound_rows=885, ti_row_count=885, total_advisories=60. Frontend: dashboard flips live without reload; ti-data-source-chip and kpi-total-advisories update via React Query invalidation. Only nit is the 'Rows in file' label in UploadModal showing first-sheet count for multi-sheet xlsx.
rca of the issue: Original 0-rows behavior for Welspun_July_2026.xlsx had two root causes, both fixed: (a) ti_ingest._CANONICAL didn't map the header 'Name'/'Title'/'Sector' — now added; (b) pandas read_excel with default sheet_name=0 skipped the second 'Grand Total' summary sheet — parse_rows now uses sheet_name=None and aggregates _rows_from_df across all sheets. Verified real file yields 885 bound IOC rows and 60 distinct advisories.
